events.description: Opening production credits and character cast lists are displayed on screen.
A miniature cityscape establishing shot reveals a lit clock tower showing midnight.
Pedestrians and a newsboy walk along the sidewalk outside the entrance to Police Headquarters.
A police vehicle exits the entrance archway of Police Headquarters onto the street.
The driver navigates the police vehicle along illuminated street routes at night.
The police car stops at the entrance steps of a stone building while an officer walks down the stairs.
A man wearing a suit sits back-facing at a large wooden desk in an office reading a piece of paper.
John Bell holds and reads a warning letter signed by 'The Bat' at his desk.
Police officers and a detective wait in the hallway near the library entrance.
John Bell adjusts and checks a small clock on his desk.
A gloved hand reaches through an open window sill from outside.
A man in a dark suit leans out an open window holding a cord.
The butler pulls back a wall curtain and opens a small hidden safe.
The police chief holds and inspects a paper note alongside the butler and sergeant.
Officers and men assemble in the library under an overlaid clock graphic.
A figure stands in shadow looking down into a fortified bank vault.
A worker stands and moves in front of a massive circular bank vault door.
A vintage car exits a garage structure onto an exterior ground area.
A man carrying a bag walks through the stone-pillared iron gate labeled FLEMING.
A man wearing a hat and coat walks across dark exterior grounds carrying a bag.
Lizzie Allen stands next to Cornelia Van Gorder in the great hall, gesturing and talking while Cornelia knits.
Lizzie expresses distress while speaking with Miss Cornelia.
Close-up of feet walking across the floor.
Lizzie and Miss Cornelia place their fingers on the planchette of a Ouija board.
Cornelia Van Gorder and Lizzie place their hands on a planchette over a Ouija board while sitting at a desk.
A figure moves through a low basement window opening in the dark cellar area.
Cornelia Van Gorder descends into the basement holding a handgun, accompanied by Lizzie.
A dark cloaked figure moves along the exterior wall near a illuminated basement window.
A bat silhouette appears cast against the exterior wall.
Maid runs up the basement stairs in alarm.
Maid lies on the floor under the raised bed.
Maid bends over to pick up a trap from the floor.
Maid presents a newspaper reporting a bank robbery to Cornelia.
Billy speaks and gestures in an agitated manner while conversing with Cornelia Van Gorder and Lizzie.
Cornelia Van Gorder walks briskly toward the exit of the room while gesturing, as Lizzie looks on nervously.
Cornelia walks toward the window as Lizzie reacts fearfully.
Dale converses with Brooks in the garage beside an automobile.
Lizzie speaks nervously to Cornelia in the Great Hall near a suit of armor.
Dale enters the Great Hall and opens her handbag next to Cornelia.
Caretaker Billy peeks cautiously through the doorway watching the group in the Great Hall.
Dale Van Gorder leans down and speaks to Cornelia Van Gorder while she continues knitting.
Jack Brooks stands holding his cap and speaks to Cornelia Van Gorder in the Great Hall.
Cornelia Van Gorder sits in an armchair knitting while other household members move around the hall.
Lizzie bends down and speaks excitedly to Cornelia Van Gorder.
Cornelia and Lizzie examine an umbrella and inspect a paper note attached to it near the entryway.
Lizzie reacts with visible fear and grasps Cornelia's arm as Cornelia holds the note and purse.
Dr. Wells speaks directly with Cornelia Van Gorder while holding his hat in his hands.
Dr. Wells holds his hat while speaking to Miss Cornelia Van Gorder.
Dr. Wells steps through an open doorway.
Miss Cornelia Van Gorder stands facing a closed door or wall panel.
A man wearing a vest stands facing a wall-mounted telephone apparatus.
Dale Ogden walks past the base of the staircase while looking toward a man.
Miss Cornelia Van Gorder sits across from a young man holding a hat at an octagonal table in the Great Hall.
Cornelia Van Gorder sits at a table opposite a man in a suit with a hat placed on the table.
Doctor Wells reaches down toward a desktop bell and tray while Dale Ogden stands nearby.
Doctor Wells stands near tall curtained French doors.
Doctor Wells carries a coat over his arm near the bottom of the main staircase.
Doctor Wells holds a small object and speaks directly with Dale Ogden.
Doctor Wells opens the double doors and walks through them.
Dale Ogden reaches up to press a light switch on the wall near a cabinet.
Dale Ogden peers through the gap between double doors while Cornelia Van Gorder and the man in a suit remain seated at the table in the foreground.
Cornelia Van Gorder sits at an octagonal table conversing with a man in a dark suit, with a hat and gloves placed on the table between them.
Dale Ogden watches the conversation through the narrow gap between the closed double doors.
A young man talks with Dale Ogden near the base of the staircase in the hallway.
The young man turns and walks up the staircase in the hallway alone.
Detective Anderson writes in a notepad while speaking with Cornelia Van Gorder.
Lizzie opens the double door and enters the hall.
Detective Anderson questions Lizzie and writes down her response.
Cornelia Van Gorder walks up the grand staircase while looking down at Anderson.
Detective Anderson stands alone in the dark hall inspecting his surroundings.
Young woman runs past staircase entry.
Man peers past door frame while female silhouette uses telephone.
Man walks past entrance columns and ascends stairs.
Maid works near table lamp and turns around startled.
Maid turns and runs off as occupants gather.
Dale walks across the main hall near the grand staircase.
Detective Anderson stands near the staircase with Dale.
A man in a suit runs cautiously along an upper hallway.
Billy lies amongst laundry sacks on the basement floor after falling.
Dale Van Gorder sits in an armchair talking with the man sitting across from her.
Dale Van Gorder gets up from the armchair and walks away while the man watches.
The man in the overcoat reaches toward a bookshelf holding a rolled document.
Dale Van Gorder walks past decorative doors and a dining table in a grand hallway.
Dale Van Gorder stands near a table talking intently face-to-face with the man in the overcoat.
Cornelia walks into the hall joining Lizzie, Dale, Brooks, and Detective Anderson.
Detective Anderson speaks directly with Cornelia while examining a small object in hand.
Detective Anderson carries rolled papers across the room and unrolls blueprints before Dale and the group.
Detective Anderson leans close to speak directly to a tearful Dale Ogden.
Richard speaks closely and intensely to a weeping Dale Ogden.
Richard leans down toward seated Dale surrounded by household members.
A man stands outside at the curtained balcony window.
A man in a coat stands near the doorway while others turn toward him.
Richard talks face-to-face with the bowler-hatted detective while holding a wallet.
The detective gestures and speaks to Cornelia Van Gorder.
Richard places a call on the wall phone as the detective, Lizzie, and Cornelia watch.
Young man speaks into wall telephone while others listen nearby.
A man runs down an exterior hedge-lined walkway at night.
The group inspects a large framed portrait on the wall.
A figure in a coat walks up a dark, narrow secret staircase.
Detective stands on a stepladder to examine the painting above the fireplace.
Cornelia and Lizzie look upward reactively in the hall.
Detective Anderson quickly steps past a visibly alarmed Dale Ogden.
Brook enters the hall through an open rear doorway.
Doctor Wells stands in the hall talking with Dale Ogden and Detective Anderson.
A silhouetted figure moves quickly past a latticed window.
Doctor Wells leans on the stair post while speaking to Dale and Cornelia.
Dr. Sterling leans against the staircase banister post while speaking to Cornelia Van Gorder and Dale Ogden.
Detective Anderson, wearing a bowler hat and coat, gestures while speaking to Cornelia Van Gorder.
Dr. Sterling leans close to speak directly with Cornelia Van Gorder.
Dr. Sterling holds open a set of paneled doors while speaking to Lizzie Allen.
Richard Fleming peers out from behind a dark curtain.
Richard Fleming stands closely facing Dr. Sterling near the paneled doors and speaks to him.
Richard Fleming speaks closely to Dr. Wells while holding paper documents.
Dr. Wells turns and walks away down the hallway stairs.
Richard Fleming stands alone near the chair holding his papers after Dr. Wells leaves.
A silhouette is seen peering through the lattice glass door pane.
Dr. Sterling peers through a doorway split and raises a heavy wooden object overhead.
Dr. Sterling exits through double doors and walks along the upper hallway landing past a large decorative vase.
Cornelia speaks into the mounted telephone near the staircase while Lizzie stands beside a smoking hot water bottle on an armchair.
Detective Anderson stands in the hall conversing with Cornelia and Lizzie near the framed portrait.
Billy advances through a dark corridor while holding an illuminated lantern.
Caretaker walks down dark hallway carrying lit lantern.
Masked figure wearing black mask appears behind caretaker.
Detective Anderson moves large framed portrait near stairs.
Detective Anderson draws and aims revolver at doorway.
Detective Anderson stands over collapsed man with revolver drawn.
Miss Cornelia converses with Detective Anderson.
A man pulls heavy double doors shut while Dale stands behind him.
A figure in a coat fires a handgun toward the manor exterior from the lawn at night.
Occupants push heavy wooden furniture against double doors to barricade them.
Detective Anderson speaks directly with Dale and Brook in close proximity.
A man lies prone on a rug on the floor near a door and cushion.
Detective Anderson stands with the group holding a handgun at his side in the hall.
A cloaked figure crouches low in front of a window paned frame.
The cloaked figure works with coiled wire on the floor.
A woman in a gown runs up small stairs toward an open door in the dark upper level.
Dale Ogden walks across the room while carrying a lit candle toward the fireplace wall.
Dale Ogden reaches up to touch and operate the mechanism located on the side of the fireplace mantel.
The fireplace wall structure pivots open on hinges, uncovering a secret doorway.
Dale Ogden steps through the revealed secret opening holding the candle.
The secret panel door swings closed, shutting off the passage from view.
Bearded man looks through a narrow opening in the doorway.
Woman leans over the wooden desk near a candle.
A cloaked figure casts a bat shadow and crouches on the floor.
Woman presses her hands and knocks on the wall panel door.
Dale Van Order opens a door, peering nervously into the darkened space.
Lizzie Allen walks near the Great Hall staircase and confers anxiously with Billy and Detective Anderson.
A gloved hand reaches out from behind a marble pillar and snuffs out the candle flame.
Billy grimaces while standing beside Detective Anderson.
Detective Anderson in coat and hat steps through an interior doorway into the upstairs room.
Detective Anderson talks directly to Miss Cornelia as Dale and Brooks walk toward the background doorway.
The masked figure wearing a dark bat cloak leaps or runs down a wooden flight of stairs.
Billy and Detective Anderson look up in alarm as smoke billows near the Great Hall staircase next to a suit of armor.
Detective Anderson leans over a wooden table to inspect its surface while Miss Cornelia stands holding her cane.
Miss Cornelia walks across the room using a cane toward Detective Anderson standing near a table.
Brook stands framed in the doorway looking sternly toward Detective Anderson.
Detective Anderson faces Brook at close proximity while speaking directly to him.
The police officer searches Detective Anderson's coat pockets and pulls out a handgun.
Detective Anderson aims two revolvers at a man seated on a chair in the room.
Richard Fleming stands over and looks down at the seated injured man.
Dr. Wells inspects the distressed man's head, jaw, and eyes closely.
Detective Anderson holds two handguns pointed across the attic room.
Dale Ogden and others exit out through the narrow door frame in the back.
Detective Anderson walks into the passageway opening near the fireplace.
The distressed man rises from his chair and reaches toward the table.
An injured man in a stained shirt reaches across a table for a small revolver.
Men inspect an opened hidden wall panel and safe while onlookers watch inside the room.
A black-gloved hand reaches from behind a secret wall partition and grabs Lizzie's shoulder.
Lizzie jumps down the wooden staircase in panic after being startled.
Cornelia Van Gorder and others gather around the opened hidden door panel in the attic wall.
A man steps through the open secret panel into the small room housing the safe.
Detective Anderson walks past the secret panel towards the open window.
A character looks out through the open window down a long ladder extending outside the building.
Anderson holds a cloaked figure and inspects confiscated handguns while household members observe.
Anderson speaks to an associate while holding two handguns.
Men run down the interior stairs.
A dark cloaked figure runs across the lawn holding a satchel.
Lizzie sits up in bed showing a shocked facial expression.
Lizzie looks terrified while lying in bed with curlers in her hair.
Men tackle the cloaked figure onto the lawn as Lizzie watches.
Detective Anderson stands beside the captured, bound cloaked figure on the lawn.
The Bat holds a gun on the group, forcing them to raise their hands.
Men restrain and bind the caped suspect against a tree using rope.
The unmasked suspect speaks while tied to the tree in close-up.
An actor steps before a theater curtain to deliver an epilogue to the viewers.
Chester Morris stands in front of a curtain dressed in formal tuxedo tails and speaks directly to the camera.
The closing title card stating 'The End - A Roland West Attraction' is displayed on screen.
